 Montgomery County District Court
 Cause No. 2024-CV-0026
 Brenda Christian, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Plaintiff's Original Petition
Filed:
July 9, 2024
Plaintiff's counsel:
Andrew Lewis, Johnson & Lowery Injury Lawyers
PARTIES
Plaintiff Brenda Christian is an individual resiidng in Texas who was the driver of a passenger vehicle involved in the collision
described below. Defendant is an automobile insurance company authorized to write personal auto policies in the State of Texas,
which issued the policy under which Plaintiff seeks benefits.
FACTS
On May 12, 2023, Plaintiff was lawfully operating his vehicle on a public roadway in Pasadena when another vehicle crossed
into his lane and struck his car head-on. The impact occurred at low speed, but it was forceful enough to jolt Plaintiff's body
violently against his seat and restraint system. Plaintiff reported the collision to Defendant promptly and submitted the
information Defendant requested. Despite this, Defendant has delayed evaluating the claim and has not paid the medical expenses
and vehicle-related losses Plaintiff incurred as a result.
NEGLIGENCE
Defendant owed Plaintiff a duty under its policy and under Texas law to investigate and handle his claim in good faith, to
communicate with him reasonably, and to pay covered benefits within the time required by the Texas Insurance Code. Defendant
breached these duties by failing to conduct a prompt and reasonable investigation, by unreasonably delaying payment, and by
failing to explain the basis for its position in writing. These failures caused Plaintiff economic harm and prolonged his physical
distress.
DAMAGES
As a direct result of the collision and Defendant's conduct, Plaintiff sustained a back strain that has required treatment, restricted
his daily activities, and caused ongoing pain. Plaintiff has incurred medical expenses, lost wages, and out-of-pocket costs, and he
will likely incur additional care in the future. Plaintiff seeks actual damages, statutory interest, attorney's fees, and court costs.
Plaintiff demands judgment against Defendant in the amount of $84,000.00, together with all other relief to which he is entitled.
